resources.string: Official Omni Evolution Beta Addon! Custom evolution dimension, Vilgax boss animations, custom combat controllers, and extra alien variants.
Epic anime adventure! Legendary Devil Fruits with special moves, Busoshoku & Kenbunshoku Haki, Marine & Pirate mobs, legendary katanas (Yoru, Enma), and custom 3D bosses!
🔮 SLIME SKILLS • GREAT SAGE • DEMON LORDS
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime! Great Sage mental HUD overlay, Predator skill mimicry, magicules system, Direwolves, Goblins, Charybdis and Demon Lord abilities!
High-speed Omni-Bound v1.5.2! Instant quick-switch alien dials, ultimate forms, custom boss raids, drone attacks, and cinematic transformation sequences.
🐉 SAIYAN FORMS • KI BLASTS • CUSTOM BOSSES
Massive Dragon Evolution experience! Transform into Super Saiyan, unleash Kamehameha & Final Flash ki attacks, custom dimensions, and battle epic anime bosses!
Ultra-detailed 3D firearms for Minecraft Bedrock! Custom recoil, first-person reload animations, sniper scopes, shotguns, assault rifles, and tactical combat!
⚡ ONE FOR ALL • EXPLOSION • HEROES VS VILLAINS
Awaken your Quirk! One For All, Explosion, Decay, Overhaul, Half-Cold Half-Hot, craft hero/villain gear, fight Nomus, and unlock custom super moves!
Suit up as Tony Stark! Fly at supersonic speeds with custom animations, fire repulsor blasts & unibeam, equip nano-tech armor, launch micro-missiles, and activate JARVIS HUD!
Become the Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man! Fluid 3D web swinging through cities, wall climbing, Spider-Sense danger alerts, Symbiote & Iron Spider suits, and battle iconic villains!
The Ultimate Marvel Universe in Bedrock! Summon Mjolnir lightning, throw Cap\'s vibranium shield, unsheathe adamantium claws, open Doctor Strange portals, and wield the Infinity Gauntlet!
Dragon Ball Sparking in Minecraft Bedrock! Awaken Super Saiyan transformations, charge your ki aura, launch explosive Kamehameha blasts, and battle legendary DBZ warriors!
ATTACK ON TITAN: WINGS OF FREEDOM
Dedicate your heart! Equip 3D Maneuver (ODM) Gear with fluid grapple mechanics, dual thunder spears, transform into the Attack Titan, and defend the Walls from Titans!
🗡️ SHADOW MONARCH • SYSTEM QUESTS • DUNGEON RAIDS
Arise as the Shadow Monarch! Awaken Jinwoo\'s Hunter System, complete daily quests, level up stats, clear red gates & dungeons, and extract defeated enemies as loyal Shadow Soldiers!
